    def preprocess_input(self, input_data, context="english"):
        if context in {"genomic", "real-time"} and "genomic" in input_data.lower():
            input_data = self._fetch_genomic_data(input_data)
        elif context == "neural" and "eeg" in input_data.lower():
            input_data = self._fetch_eeg_data(input_data)
        elif context == "nuclear" and "fusion" in input_data.lower():
            input_data = self._fetch_nuclear_data(input_data)
        tokens = re.split(r'[-\s,]+', input_data)
        tokens = [t.upper() if "A" in t else t.lower() for t in tokens]
        phonemes = []
        for token in tokens:
            if token in self.pul_terns:
                phonemes.append(self.pul_terns[token])
            else:
                phonemes.append(self._infer_mapping(token, context))  # Dynamic mapping
        context_mod = self._apply_fsuit_context(" ".join(tokens), context)
        phonemes = [context_mod if context_mod else p for p in phonemes]
        return phonemes
    def _infer_mapping(self, token, context):
        # Dynamic mapping for unmapped terms
        fallback = {
            "biological": "life_process", "ecological": "ecosystem_dynamics",
            "geological": "mineral_formation", "paleontological": "fossil_dynamics",
            "nuclear": "energy_process", "atomic": "chemical_structure"
        }
        return fallback.get(context, "generic_dynamics")
    def _fetch_genomic_data(self, input_data):
        gene_map = {"HBB": "ATG-GTG-CAC-CTG", "CFTR": "ATG-ATT-CAA-GAA", "BRCA1": "ATG-GAT-TAT-GCT"}
        return gene_map.get(input_data.split("_")[-1], "ATG-GTG-CAC-TAA")
    def _fetch_eeg_data(self, input_data):
        return "eeg_alpha" if "alpha" in input_data.lower() else "eeg_theta"
    def _fetch_nuclear_data(self, input_data):

    def _apply_fsuit_context(self, token, context):
        if context == "cosmological":
            if "h" in token: return "hubble"
        elif context == "biological":
            if any(codon in token for codon in ["ATG", "TAA", "CAA"]): return "life_process"
        elif context == "neural":
            if "eeg" in token.lower(): return "consciousness_signal"
        elif context == "nuclear":
            if any(nuc in token for nuc in ["H2", "D-T"]): return "fusion_process"
        elif context == "atomic":
            if any(atom in token for atom in ["1s2", "H2O"]): return "chemical_structure"
        elif context == "geological":
            if any(mineral in token for mineral in ["SiO2", "CaCO3"]): return "mineral_formation"
        elif context == "quantum":
            if "superposition" in token: return "quantum_state"
        elif context == "astrophysical":
            if "bh_collapse" in token: return "cosmic_event"
        elif context == "material":
            if "graphene" in token: return "material_property"
        elif context == "ecological":
            if any(eco in token for eco in ["coral_reef", "carbon_cycle"]): return "ecosystem_dynamics"
            elif "cycle" in token.lower(): return "biogeochemical_flow"
        elif context == "paleontological":
            if any(paleo in token for paleo in ["trilobite", "T_rex", "K-Pg_extinction"]):
                return "fossil_dynamics"
            elif "extinction" in token.lower(): return "evolutionary_reset"
            elif "transition" in token.lower(): return "evolutionary_shift"
        elif context == "mythological":
            if "an" in token: return "sky_domain"
        elif context == "administrative":
            if "da" in token: return "transfer"
        elif context == "paranormal":
            if "emf" in token: return "primordial_signal"
        return None
    def _modulate_fsuit(self, meaning, phoneme, context, params):

        delta_ph = params["delta_ph"].get(context, 0.0)

        damping = math.exp(-eta_eff) / (params["m_pl"] * 1e-6) * f_ex
        resonance = 1 + delta_ph + params["g"] * 20

    def synthesize(self, phonemes, target_lang="english"):
        translation = []
        params = self.fsuit_params
        for p in phonemes:
            meaning = self._modulate_fsuit(p, p, target_lang, params)
            translation.append(meaning)
        if target_lang == "english":
            return " ".join(translation).capitalize() + "."
        elif target_lang == "spanish":
            return f"El {' '.join(translation[1:])} es {' '.join(translation[1:])}, ".capitalize()

            return f"Ta {' '.join(translation[:-1])}, {translation[-1]} shi."

            return f"ال{' '.join(translation[:-1])} ھﻮ {' '.join(translation[:-1])}, ".capitalize()

    def translate(self, input_data, context="english", target_lang="english"):
        phonemes = self.preprocess_input(input_data, context)
        translation = self.synthesize(phonemes, target_lang)
        return {"phonemes": phonemes, "translation": translation}

                result = pflt.translate(test, context=ctx, target_lang=lang)
                print(f"Input: {test} -> {lang}")
                print(f"Phonemes: {result['phonemes']}")
                print(f"Translation: {result['translation']}")
